mapper.delete: delete from goodscollection.taglist where userId=#{userId} and ipId=#{ipId}
mapper.select: select ip.* from goodscollection.taglist inner join goodscollection.ip on taglist.ipId = ip.ipId where userId=#{userId}
select * from goodscollection.ip where ipId not in (select taglist.ipId from goodscollection.taglist where userId=#{userId})
